captions.detailed: A rack-style two-branch rotary tree assembly consisting of a vertical square-profile spine grounded on a cross-shaped base plate. Mounted at different heights on opposite sides of the spine are two independent horizontal branch modules. One branch terminates in a simple square pad, while the other branch terminates in a u-shaped fork. Each branch module is attached via a bracket saddle and articulates as an independent revolute joint rotating about its own horizontal axis.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a rack-style two-branch rotary tree. The model should feature a grounded vertical spine with a cross-shaped base, and two independent horizontal branch arms mounted on side brackets at different heights. One arm should end in a flat pad and the other in a terminal fork, with both arms configured as independent revolute joints.
captions.factory: Construct a base assembly using crossed rectangular plates and extrude a vertical square column as the main spine. Model two separate branch arms as distinct parts: one arm with a square end pad and the other with a slotted fork tip. Create saddle bracket mounts to attach to the spine at offset heights. Define revolute joints connecting each branch arm to its respective bracket hub, rotating about horizontal axes.
